title: Code questions are claimed like research: a claim names a repository, path and symbol, and a second agent mapping the same code sees the overlap and gets the results
goal: coord.py dedup --code REPO:PATH[#SYMBOL] (repeatable) claims code targets under keys of their own beside the research terms; a claim on a path covers its symbols; another holder's dedup of a covered target lists it in overlaps and claims only the rest; the holder posts each code fact or map entry it adds as a code_added event (fields target for REPO:PATH[#SYMBOL] and ref for path:line) of the closed kinds, which coord.py wait --kind code_added returns, so a waiting agent reads those instead of reading the code; on a temp store a second holder's dedup of the same path reports the first holder's overlap.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
t=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'c.sqlite')
c=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py',*a,'--store',t] if a[0]!='wait' else [sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','wait','--store',t,*a[1:]],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
p=c('post','--kind','code_added','--field','target=it-ops-kb:_tools/rag.py#pack','--field','ref=_tools/rag.py:10')
w=c('wait','--since','0','--timeout','0','--kind','code_added')
x=c('post','--kind','code_whatever','--field','target=x')
print(p.returncode,p.stdout[-200:],p.stderr[-200:],w.stdout[-400:],x.returncode)
try:
    ev=json.loads(w.stdout).get('events') or []
except ValueError:
    ev=[]
ok=p.returncode==0 and any(e.get('kind')=='code_added' and e['fields'].get('target')=='it-ops-kb:_tools/rag.py#pack' for e in ev) and x.returncode!=0
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
